# Kona Compass

> Kona Compass is a professional-grade motorized transducer rotator for live sonar fishing systems. It gives anglers precise, heading-based control over transducer direction — with heading hold, auto search, direction lock, wireless remote, and foot pedal. Pre-order stage.

Kona Compass solves the core problem of manual transducer mounts: they have no mechanism to hold heading. Current, wind, and boat movement cause the transducer to drift off target continuously. Kona Compass replaces manual correction with a motorized heading control system that reacts in real time using a built-in orientation sensor.

## Compatible systems

- Garmin Panoptix LiveScope — LVS32, LVS34, LVS34-IF
- Lowrance ActiveTarget — ActiveTarget, ActiveTarget 2, ActiveTarget 2 XL
- Humminbird MEGA Live Imaging

Compatibility is not brand-locked. The rotator works across all three major live sonar platforms.

## Key features

- **Heading hold** — locks onto a compass heading and corrects drift automatically. No manual input required during fishing.
- **Auto search** — sweeps a configurable sector angle automatically. Hands-free coverage of water while searching for fish.
- **Direction lock** — fixes a precise heading rigidly for repeatable, fixed positioning on structure.
- **Manual mode** — direct motorized control via foot pedal or wireless remote. Instant response.
- **Wireless remote** — full control from anywhere on the boat. Included in the box.
- **Foot pedal (control pedal)** — dual-switch pedal for speed and sector adjustment. Included in the box.

## Construction

- 100% marine-grade stainless steel — zero aluminum, eliminating galvanic corrosion risk in saltwater
- Hermetically sealed housing — protects sensors and motor from saltwater, spray, and humidity
- Speed protection — mounting bracket folds automatically at higher boat speeds
- Maintenance-free internals — composite bearings, no greasing required
- Temperature range: −10°C to +60°C storage

## Pricing

€990–1190. Pre-order. Waitlist open at konacompass.com.

## Competitors

- **SonarPointer (S-Pointer)** — motorized rotator, foot pedal, autoscan. No built-in orientation sensor for true heading hold. Limited cross-brand compatibility.
- **LiveScanner** — integrates with trolling motor for hands-free rotation. Requires compatible trolling motor; does not work as standalone mount.
- **Manual poles** (Traxstech, RAM, DIY) — universal fit, no motorized control, no heading hold, no auto search.

Kona Compass is the only motorized transducer rotator with a built-in orientation system, heading hold across four operating modes, and full compatibility with Garmin, Lowrance, and Humminbird without requiring a specific trolling motor.
